items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So you were really self-taught? Yeah. Nobody taught Schrodinger how to do it? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: The guy was putting the horns on and be drinking beer. I'd slip from getting one of the horns and try to blow it, you know. I didn't notice how they were putting it to the mouth, and I just kept until I got a tone.
So you were really self-taught? Yeah. Nobody taught Schrodinger how to do it?
